cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: the paved square before a city gate tower — carries her keepsake low at her side; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a quiet library reading room with tall bookshelves — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a Peking opera dressing room — standing at a work surface; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her; a domed marble hammam with warm stone slabs and brass bowls — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — standing; a towering magic library where books drift slowly through the air between tall shelves — reads a glowing spellbook with drifting rune light held open in both hands; a photo studio with a seamless paper backdrop sweeping onto the floor — tilts a round gold-and-silver photo reflector to bounce light onto her face; overgrown jungle temple ruins — sitting on the ground; a sunny seaside boardwalk lined with palms — holds her keepsake up beside her face
